card.name: Small words in blood-pressure regulation phrases
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, reduced, and, to) inside text about blood pressure, orthostatic hypotension and blood volume, mostly in dopamine agonist warnings. The word sits just before a circulation-related term.

modes.label: Before blood volume or pressure
modes.description: A word like 'of' or 'reduced' sits right before 'blood' in a sentence about maintaining blood pressure.
modes.example: has already been compromised by a<< reduced>> blood volume or concurrent administration of certain CNS

modes.label: Within hypotension treatment lists
modes.description: A linking word appears in text about low blood pressure drugs or test doses.

card.writes: It promotes circulation-related words such as circulation, circ, card and peripheral, so the next word is likely to be about circulation.
card.plain: It fires on small words just before the text turns to blood circulation or blood pressure.
